scope: 13 active skill artworks plus passive icon; presentation-only Phaser integration
approvalEvidence: I explicitly waive concept and final-art approval gates for this task. Do not stop to request approval between stages.

provenance.method: Original built-in OpenAI image_gen raster concepts and new action/VFX drawings; measured preparation and editable Aseprite export.
references: Actual Thieu Lam monk is in the lower half of artwork/thieu-lam-thien-son.png.
vo_dang_art_direction_reference.png is absent; vo_dang_character_reference.png is the actual inspected style reference.
current_codex_dashboard_anti_reference.png actually contains a Vo Dang sheet; wuxia_town_world_reference.png is the actual exterior-dashboard negative.
in_game_world_reference.png and thien_son_thieu_lam_character_reference.png depict the same detailed town scene.
provenance.license: Original AI-assisted project assets; supplied school references guide style only. No proprietary game sprite extraction; no claim of human hand-pixelled authorship or independently reviewed approval.

normalAttackReuse.policy: Approved normal clips reused unchanged, never regenerated.

limitations: Phaser preview only; live skill mechanics unavailable and unchanged.
Bất Động Minh Vương healing artwork follows current documentation; possible mitigation redesign remains open.
Empowered finishers are optional target-specific presentations; no global combo rule.
Effect timing, radius and counts are illustrative; client visuals never determine damage or eligibility.
